item.title: Idaho Lawmakers Look to Narrow 340B Reporting Law as Minnesota Delays Action on Strengthened Contract Pharmacy Bill
item.description: Idaho legislators recently introduced a bill to simplify the state’s current 340B provider reporting law enacted last year, while Minnesota lawmakers postponed action on legislation to strengthen the state’s existing contract pharmacy access statute.

item.title: How State Prescription Drug Affordability Boards Could Affect 340B Savings
item.description: As prescription drug affordability boards take shape in states across the country, 340B experts have raised concerns over potential impacts on the program.

item.title: Webinar--The Current 340B Landscape and Preparing for the Future: What Covered Entities Should Be Doing Now
item.description: SPONSORED CONTENT Join 340B Report’s Ted Slafsky for timely updates on 340B policy developments, including the latest on the 340B [...]

item.title: Advocacy Group Launches Litigation Fund to Help States Defend 340B Contract Pharmacy Access Laws
item.description: A national 340B advocacy group on Wednesday launched a new fund aimed at helping states defend 340B contract pharmacy access laws against a growing wave of drugmaker lawsuits.

item.title: House Members Circulate Letter to Ban 340B Rebate Model in Federal Funding Bill
item.description: A group of bipartisan key U.S. House lawmakers are pushing to include language in a must-pass federal appropriations bill that would block implementation of a 340B rebate model.

item.title: Congress Prepares FY 2027 Federal Spending Proposal that Could Include 340B Provisions
item.description: U.S. House lawmakers have until the end of this week to request proposals—including language that could affect the 340B program—as part of an appropriations bill that would fund the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) for the federal fiscal year (FY) that begins in October.

item.title: RxParadigm 340B Solution Spotlight
item.description: In this 340B Report Sponsor Solution Spotlight, RxParadigm describes their Tungsten+PLUS product for 340B covered entities.

item.title: State Contract Pharmacy Lawsuit Roundup: Actions in Oklahoma, Rhode Island and New Mexico
item.description: Key updates in contract pharmacy lawsuits occurred in Oklahoma, Rhode Island and New Mexico.

item.title: J&J Adds Two Drugs to 340B Contract Pharmacy Restrictions, Tells Providers to Self-Identify MFP Overpayments
item.description: Pharmaceutical giant Johnson & Johnson (J&J) recently updated its 340B contract pharmacy restrictions to add two new medications and extend its state-level exemptions to Louisiana covered entities.

item.title: PhRMA Pushes For a 340B Rebate Model as 340B Health Lobbies on the Hill
item.description: The Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America push for a 340B rebate model in a new paper.

item.title: U.S. Senate Report Highlights Medicaid Drug Pricing Loophole that 340B Experts Warn Could Affect Provider Savings
item.description: A recent U.S. Senate report found that a U.K.-based pharmaceutical giant used a loophole to reap profits and avoid Medicaid penalties after raising the prices for one of its most-prescribed inhalers—a practice which some 340B experts argued is likely wider spread and effecting provider savings through that drug pricing program.

item.title: 340B’s Catch-22: Automation Solutions
item.description: CompassRx’s Chief Operating Officer Alice Cheng shares advice for 340B covered entities looking to utilize automation solutions.

item.title: Federal Judge Tosses Second Drug Industry Challenge to Tennessee’s 340B Contract Pharmacy Access Law
item.description: A Tennessee federal judge on Monday dismissed a major pharmaceutical industry trade group’s lawsuit challenging the state’s 340B contract pharmacy access law, just three weeks after she tossed a drugmaker’s separate challenge to the law.

item.title: Washington Governor Signs Sweeping 340B Law, Immediately Draws Two Drugmaker Lawsuits
item.description: Washington Gov. Bob Ferguson (D) signed a sweeping 340B bill into law Wednesday, making the Evergreen State the 22nd to enact a 340B contract pharmacy access law and the first to combine those protections with 340B reporting requirements for both drugmakers and providers.

item.title: Nearly 100 Bipartisan U.S. House Members Ask Appropriations Leaders to Block 340B Rebate Model in Spending Bill
item.description: U.S. House members are asking congressional leadership to include language in a spending bill that bans the use of a 340B rebate model.
